description:
Returns one place by its geoHash and id, as returned by search_places: name, category, address, coordinates, opening hours, contacts, description, images and whether it takes bookings on Pinsvit; no authentication.
A bookable place is booked with get_place_services, find_booking_times and create_booking.

geoHash.description: geoHash of the place, returned next to its id by search_places.

name: get_place

bookable.description: True when the place takes bookings on Pinsvit; the booking tools work only then.

claimed.description: True when a business runs the place on Pinsvit.

contacts.description: Contact lines as the business wrote them: phone, email, website.

description.description: Description written by the business; absent when none.

id.description: Place id; identifies the place together with geoHash.

medias.description: Public URLs of the place's images.

openHours.description: Weekly opening periods (day 1 = Monday, times HH:mm local); a weekday with no period is closed.

status.description: The venue's operating status as imported, e.g. open or closed; absent when unknown.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the opening hours are in, e.g. Europe/Kyiv.

url.description: Public page of the place; absent for an unclaimed place, which has no page.

title: Get place
